# ReceiptToCSV

> Document scanning SaaS that turns photographed or uploaded receipts, invoices, bank statements, and credit card statements into organized, exportable data — itemized totals, taxes, transactions, balances, and due dates included, exportable as CSV, PDF, or JSON. Available as a web app and native iOS/Android apps. No login required to try it.

ReceiptToCSV uses AI to extract structured data from four document types: receipts (store, line items, totals, taxes, payment method), invoices (vendor, line items, due date, amount due), bank statements (institution, transactions, opening/closing balance), and credit card statements (issuer, transactions, balance, payment due date) — with duplicate detection and support for batch uploads. Plans range from a free tier (20 scans/month) to Premium and Team tiers with shared organization scan pools, an admin portal, and an AI assistant for querying document history.

- [Invoice to CSV](https://receipttocsv.dev/invoice-to-csv/): Converting invoices to CSV/Excel
- [Tax Season Guide](https://receipttocsv.dev/tax-season-guide/): Organizing and categorizing receipts for tax filing
